title: What Did Parasite Do That No Film Had Done at the Oscars?

lines.text: What did Parasite do that no film had done at the Oscars?
Parasite is a 2019 South Korean film directed by Bong Joon Ho.
At the 2020 Academy Awards, it won four awards.
Best Picture, Best Director, Best Original Screenplay, and Best International Feature.
It became the first non-English-language film to win Best Picture.
Subscribe for the next film fact.

description: At the 92nd Academy Awards (9 February 2020), Parasite, directed by Bong Joon Ho, won Best Picture, Best Director, Best Original Screenplay and Best International Feature Film, and became the first non-English-language film to win Best Picture.
